### 🌟 Highlights

PlayGuard's biggest release yet: a new look, homebrew on the HOME menu behind the PIN, and settings that apply at once.

* 🎨 **Cadran, a new look**: every screen redrawn, tiles first on every tab, dark by default, screens that move (in full on the dock, lighter in hand, or *Reduced motion*), and *Larger text* on the whole frame.
* 🎮 **Homebrew on the HOME menu**: PlayGuard or any homebrew as a forwarder, with its own icon or one from the album's screenshots, and a user chosen at launch, made and edited in *Console › Forwarders*.
* 🔐 **Behind the PIN**: a forwarder can ask for the PIN, with hours without it, hours it never opens, a stop once the day's play time is used up and a pause after refused PINs; lock the homebrew menu, and a homebrew starts only from its forwarder.
* 🔑 **PIN and security**: a setting to pause parental controls while the parent is in PlayGuard (off by default), the PIN before going back to the previous build, and a recovery report a copy can no longer crack.
* 🌍 **Language and theme at once**: no restart, Chinese included, the focus kept where it was; flags and icons in the pickers.
* 🧭 **Menus reorganised**: PIN becomes *Security*, *Block all games* moves to the Play timer, Today gives extra time in one row and folds the checks that are fine into one pill.
* 🕒 **Console**: the network clock's measure in words ("12 s ahead"), a sys-patch tile, newer releases in a pill, the real serial number when PRODINFO is blanked, and sys-patch patches left incomplete said.
* 🌐 **A website**: the guide in every language of the console, and PlayGuard to try in a browser, at playguard.link.

Update the recovery sysmodule from the bell after this release: an older one's proof is no longer accepted. Dark is now the default theme (*Preferences › Theme*), and *Scheduled profile* reads *Soon* until the MQTT bridge.
